description_en: Queries the account information of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的账号信息
name: DescribeAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID.
SQL Server 2017 Cluster Edition instances are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
暂不支持SQL Server 2017集群系列实例
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值：1。取值为大于0且不超过Integer的最大值
parameters.name: page_number

AccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

AccountStatus.description_en:
The status of the account. Valid values:
Unavailable: The account is unavailable.
Available: The account is available
AccountStatus.description_zh:
账号状态，返回值如下：
Unavailable：不可用
Available：可用

AccountType.description_en:
The type of the account. Valid values:

Normal: standard account.
Super: privileged account.
Sysadmin (supported only for SQL Server): an account with super administrator (SA) permissions.
GlobalRO (supported only for SQL Server): global read-only account
AccountType.description_zh:
账号类型，返回值如下：

Normal：普通账号
Super：高权限账号
Sysadmin（仅SQL Server支持）：具备超级权限（SA）的账号
GlobalRO（仅SQL Server支持）：全局只读账号

BypassRLS.description_en:
Indicates whether the account has the row-level security (RLS) policy permission. Valid values:

t: Yes.
f: No.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
BypassRLS.description_zh:
是否拥有安全策略RLS权限，返回值如下：

t：是
f：否

仅PostgreSQL实例返回该参数

CheckPolicy.description_en:
Indicates whether the password policy is applied.
This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
CheckPolicy.description_zh:
是否应用密码策略
仅SQLServer实例返回该参数

CreateDB.description_en:
Indicates whether the account has the permission to create databases. Valid values:

t: Yes.
f: No.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
CreateDB.description_zh:
是否拥有创建数据库权限，返回值如下：

t：是
f：否

仅PostgreSQL实例返回该参数

CreateRole.description_en:
Indicates whether the account has the permission to create roles. Valid values:

t: Yes.
f: No.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
CreateRole.description_zh:
是否拥有创建角色权限，返回值如下：

t：是
f：否

仅PostgreSQL实例返回该参数

DBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the instance to which the account belongs

DatabasePrivilege.description_en: The list of database permissions that the account has
DatabasePrivilege.description_zh: 账号拥有的数据库权限列表

items.description_en: The details of the database permissions that the account has
items.description_zh: 账号拥有的数据库权限详情

AccountPrivilege.description_en:
The type of the account permission. Valid values:
ReadWrite: read and write.
ReadOnly: read-only.
DDLOnly: DDL only.
DMLOnly: DML only.
Custom: custom (can be modified by using SQL statements)
AccountPrivilege.description_zh:
账号的权限类型，返回值如下：
ReadWrite：读写
ReadOnly：只读
DDLOnly：仅DDL
DMLOnly：只DML
Custom：自定义（可以通过SQL命令修改）

AccountPrivilegeDetail.description_en: The specific permissions corresponding to the account permission type. For more information, see [Account permissions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146395.html）
AccountPrivilegeDetail.description_zh: 账号权限类型对应的具体权限。请参见[账号权限列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146395.html）

PasswordExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the password.
This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
PasswordExpireTime.description_zh:
密码过期时间
仅SQLServer实例返回该参数

PrivExceeded.description_en:
Indicates whether the number of databases managed by the account exceeds the upper limit. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
PrivExceeded.description_zh:
账号管理的数据库是否超过最大数量限制，返回值如下：
1：是
0：否

Replication.description_en:
Indicates whether the account has the replication permission. Valid values:

t: Yes.
f: No.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
Replication.description_zh:
是否拥有复制权限，返回值如下：

t：是
f：否

仅PostgreSQL实例返回该参数

ValidUntil.description_en: The expiration time of the password. Valid values: infinity: The password never expires. Empty: The expiration time is not specified. Actual expiration time: For example, 2022-10-01T00:00:00Z. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
ValidUntil.description_zh: 密码失效时间，返回值如下： infinity：永不过期。 返回为空：未设置。 返回实际密码失效时间。例如：2022-10-01T00:00:00Z，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间） 仅PostgreSQL实例返回该参数

SystemAdminAccountFirstActivationTime.description_en: The time when the super administrator (SA) account was first activated. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
SystemAdminAccountFirstActivationTime.description_zh: 超级权限账号首次启用时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅SQL Server实例返回该参数

SystemAdminAccountStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the super administrator (SA) account is activated. Valid values:

True: Activated.
False: Not activated.


Only ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances support the [super administrator (SA) account]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170736.html）, and this parameter has a return value. For instances of other engines, the return value is empty
SystemAdminAccountStatus.description_zh:
超级权限账号是否启用，返回值如下：

True：已启用
False：未启用


仅SQL Server实例支持[超级权限账号]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170736.html），该参数有返回值。其他引擎实例的返回值为空
